description: Generate a JPG, PNG or animated GIF preview thumbnail for an image or video, overwriting any existing preview files.
inputInstructions: overwriteExistingPreviewFiles (true/false) controls whether existing .previewFile.* thumbnails are replaced, and is set by the "Overwrite existing preview files" field. outputType selects the thumbnail format and is set by the "Thumbnail format" field: auto writes a JPG for an image and an animated GIF for a video or a large animated GIF/WebP, while jpg and png write a still (the middle frame of a video) and gif writes an animated GIF for a video or animated image. computeTier selects the compute the job runs on and is set by the "Compute tier" field: auto picks the large tier for inputs at or above the deployment's large-tier threshold and the standard tier otherwise, while standard and large run that tier for every input. An image the web already shows as its own preview (a PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP or BMP under 5 MiB) gets no preview unless the deployment turns on mediaPreviews.downscaleSelfPreviewableImages.

tagSchema.label: Overwrite existing preview files
tagSchema.description: Replace an existing .previewFile.* thumbnail for the input file. Clear it to leave an existing thumbnail in place, which reports the run successful without regenerating.

tagSchema.label: Thumbnail format
tagSchema.description: The preview file format. auto writes a JPG for an image and an animated GIF for a video or a large animated GIF/WebP; jpg and png write a still (the middle frame of a video); gif writes an animated GIF for a video or animated image, and a JPG for a still image.

tagSchema.label: Compute tier
tagSchema.description: The AWS Fargate size the job runs on. auto runs inputs at or above the deployment's large-tier threshold (2 GiB by default) on the large tier and smaller inputs on the standard tier; standard and large run that tier for every input.
